purpose: A three-argument limit(x, a, b), PSPICE's clamp, is refused by name: plain ngspice's numparam limit takes (nominal, variation).

oracle.derivation: inpcompat.c:692-695 defines the clamp only in ngspice's PSPICE mode; xpressn.c:81-85 gives plain numparam limit(nom, var). ngspice-44.2 -b prints v(p) = -0.75 for this deck (measured 2026-11-11); ESPice refuses the card (UnsupportedCard) rather than run a value.
